snacs_rules.txt: For each adposition, predict role (contextual semantic relation) and function (lexical/prepositional meaning), often identical. Spatial to toward an institution as destination: Org/Goal (Went to the school). Simple place at/on: Locus/Locus, including business/place names (at Lovely Nails; on Military Road). By in an instrumental or method adjunct: Means/Means (start by saying). Of partitive/quantifier selecting a whole: QuantityItem/Whole (Each of you). Of after an emotion/adjective, relating emotion to its subject matter: Stimulus/Topic (proud of contributions). Possessive your can mark an agentive participant's inherent or associated gestalt: Agent/Gestalt (your contributions); ordinary possessive relation can be Possessor/Possessor (your money). Throughout a time span: Duration/Duration. Distinguish role from function; preserve construal when role differs from lexical function.
